summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder votes at its August 21, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders approved an amended charter extending the business-combination deadline to September 13, 2026, with board authority to extend monthly up to September 13, 2027, and approved a trust agreement amendment. These are routine SPAC governance amendments, not a special-situation transaction. The filing discloses meeting results and quorum but no deal terms, premium, or valuation. Watch for future business-combination announcements or liquidation if no deal closes by the deadline.
